text.en:
This Order shall take effect on December 1,
1949 except the control on new items added herein which
shall take effect upon the promulgation of this Order.
Done in the City of Manila, this 24th day of December,
in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and forty-nine,
and of the independence of the Philippines, the fourth.
ELPIDIO QUIRINO
President of the Philippines
By the President:
MARCIANO ROQUE
Acting Executive Secretary
